title: 5d-review-3: review integration (review, orient, guard, MCP)
description:
## Parent

sutra/68 — 5d PRD: constraint system + DD integration

## What to review

Integration checkpoint: 5d-6 (review), 5d-7 (orient), 5d-8 (guard), 5d-9 (MCP tools).

### Focus areas

- **Review (5d-6)**: violation enrichment has enough context, diffing correctly identifies introduced vs resolved violations, waiver partition parallels convention pattern, no regression in convention review output
- **Orient (5d-7)**: constraint section is useful to agents (right level of detail), scope resolution matches convention orient behavior, waivers surfaced clearly
- **Guard (5d-8)**: blocking/advisory/informational filtering correct, waived violations never block, convention behavior unchanged
- **MCP tools (5d-9)**: tool actions follow existing conventions, JSON output is clean, waive/unwaive flow is intuitive
- **Independence**: constraint and convention systems have no data dependency — verify no accidental coupling was introduced

### Stable state after this checkpoint

Full 5d constraint system is live. End-to-end: author constraint in rules.toml → DD checks incrementally → review reports violations → orient briefs agents → guard enforces at commit → MCP tools manage waivers.

messages.author: agent
messages.text: Review: approve with notes. Integration is clean — constraint system wired end-to-end (review, orient, guard, MCP tools) without convention coupling. 1 medium finding: constraint matching logic duplicated between guard.rs and constraints/mod.rs (should share). 4 low findings: severity via Debug format, delta source-only edge removal, guard loads all waivers, shared engine mutation for delta. Test coverage thorough (24 new tests across 3 files).
